items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: The tip was more than Sarah. Yeah, he used to make a job. Never did play anything. A legend.

ctx.x: But the tips all went into one kitty.

Oh yeah, one kitty, yeah. The tip was more than Sarah. Yeah, he used to make a job. Never did play anything. A legend. A legend, man. I think that legend was going to get about a dollar and a half a night, but the tip runs about fifteen to twenty dollars. You only had four pieces.
Is that more than you made when you worked at Lutton's? What? You worked there too? The new Lutton, yeah.
